East of Port Hope, in the {wiki:Tiquanda} jungle, there is a poachers' camp. The box there, on the surface, holds 2 {item:Elephant Tusk|Elephant Tusks}.
You don't need any special equipment
Always stay close to the river to avoid the {creature:Carniphilia|Carniphilias} and most of the {creature:Spit Nettle|Spit Nettles}.

Get to **Port Hope** by boat: in Thais, Venore, Darashia, Ankrahmun, Liberty Bay or Edron talk to the ship's captain and say {key:hi}, {key:port hope}, {key:yes}. Leave **Port Hope** and follow the river along the **south** side until you reach the poachers' camp.
Location of the camp and the chest

In **Ankrahmun**, head **southwest** of the city until you find the bridge that connects to the {creature:Hydra|Hydras} spawns. Continue **southwest** from the stairs just northeast of the Hydras. This is the route over the mountains, the {wiki:Route:Ankrahmun to Port Hope|Kha'zeel Pass}: climb the mountains west of Ankrahmun, cross the bridge and go down to the stairs.
Watch out for the {creature:Hydra|Hydras} on this route.
The {creature:Hydra|Hydras} spawn is **north** of the camp. Approach slowly.
Hydras spawn north of the camp
There may be a {creature:Hydra} lured by another player waiting for you near the camp.
The quest chest is on the surface, at the camp. Open it to receive 2 {item:Elephant Tusk|Elephant Tusks}.

There is no shortcut back: return the same way, on foot. Either follow the river **west** to **Port Hope** and take {npc:Charles}'s boat at the port, or head back **northeast** by the stairs and the Kha'zeel Pass bridge to **Ankrahmun**. Stay close to the river to escape the {creature:Carniphilia|Carniphilias}.
